title: LyTeam
description: Create and join teams, share waypoints, and see your teammates positions in the world.
body:
Team is a Minecraft Forge mod for teammate coordination: create/join teams, share waypoints, see teammates' positions in the world, and send in-team messages. It is a utility mod intended to span a wide range of MC versions, so the architecture is built around isolating version-specific code from version-agnostic logic.
